remarks: Breathtaking views overlook a vast portion of the Valley. This over 5,015 sqft home on 10,552 sqft lot is situated on a cul-de-sac street with underground utilities and streetlights, ensuring a safe and convenient living environment. The home boasts large rooms with high ceilings, wood flooring, and three fireplaces. French doors open to a formal dining room with large leaded glass windows, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. A spacious family/media room is perfect for entertaining guests. Custom white oak cabinetry built-ins, surround sound speakers, accent lighting, a wet bar/refrigerator, and a fireplace complete this room. Entertainer's dream backyard, featuring a pool, spa, water
